data: At Perhaps Agency, we own the entire partner revenue engine—affiliate program management, creator and influencer partnerships,
performance PR, and high-impact channels like TikTok Shop and Amazon. We don’t just manage programs; we architect scalable growth
systems, powered by AI-driven strategy and execution.
We’re built for brands that need more than incremental gains. From launch to scale, we drive measurable revenue through curated affiliate
relationships, top-tier creators, and performance media that converts.
Perhaps offers three levels of managed services based on your brand’s revenue, active channels,
publisher recruitment needs, and level of strategic support.
Choose a monthly retainer or performance-based pricing option.
Build and launch your partner marketing program with the strategy, partners, and structure to grow.
For founder-led or brands new to partner and affiliate marketing.
Partner program analysis for 1-2 channels, performance-based media opportunities through accelerator partners, and early-stage program design and launch.
Expand existing partner activity with deeper recruitment, strategy, and campaign support.
For brands ready to formalize and scale their partnerships.
Ongoing partner management, recruitment, optimization, and publisher expansion across 2-3 active affiliate channels.
Manage your partner programs with deeper segmentation, recruitment, reporting, and cross-channel growth planning.
For mature brands with multi-channel partner ecosystems.
Full partner GTM planning for launches, seasonal campaigns, international expansion, and cross-channel growth programs.

Affiliate marketing isn't only for eight-figure brands. Through our partner marketing platform, you access vetted publishers without enterprise minimums. We recruit, manage, and optimize your program, no six-figure commitment needed.

Affiliate and influencer marketing aren't separate channels and treating them that way costs money and clarity. Perhaps manages creators as a performance channel: trackable, ROI-positive, and reported alongside every partner channel.

Performance PR connects your brand with high-intent editorial and review placements: the sites customers trust before they buy. Placements are chosen and measured for the traffic and conversions they drive, not just the mention.

Selling on Amazon doesn't rule out partner marketing; it makes it essential. As ad costs rise and algorithms shift, Amazon affiliate marketing drives listing traffic and builds the direct consumer relationship your growth depends on to succeed.

Creator commerce isn't a trend to watch but a channel to own. TikTok Shop's native creator-commerce model fits how Perhaps works. We build TikTok affiliate programs that turn creator content into trackable, repeatable revenue.

Qualified advertisers can dramatically boost partner marketing ROAS through an exclusive, zero-cost promotion from our top strategic partner. With Perhaps, you’ll enjoy complete transparency: no hidden fees, setup costs, or transaction charges.
